manifest.name: dsh-remote-dock
manifest.description: Turn any SSH host or WSL distribution into a DSH workspace: discover targets, install dsh remotely without sudo, port the local model configuration, and drive the remote DSH UI inside a sidebar panel of the local one.
manifest.author: Lee-Eee-Eee

bundle.text:
# dsh-remote-dock bundle patch: inserts the dual-face plugin row into the profile
# roster. The node half (exports ".") runs in the host process — target store,
# SSH/WSL channels, probe, bootstrap, tunnel, tunnel-backed /api/dsh-remote
# routes. The `dsh.client` declaration in package.json makes the browser half
# (exports "./client", served as /plugins/dsh-remote-dock/client.js) register the
# "Remote" sidebar entry and its center-column page.
- insert:
    - id: remote
      name: dsh-remote-dock

readme.text:
dsh-remote-dock

在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 SSH 与 WSL 远程工作区

简体中文 / English · 安装 · 使用 · 文档

`dsh-remote-dock` 为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 添加「远程」入口。连接 Linux 服务器（SSH）或 WSL 发行版后，目标上的完整 DSH 界面会出现在本地主区；文件读写和命令执行都发生在目标环境中。 *真实桌面截图。*

- **SSH 与 WSL 目标管理**：发现 SSH 配置中的主机和本机 WSL 发行版，也可手动添加。SSH 连接沿用本机密钥、agent 和跳板机配置。
- **远程环境准备**：探测 Node 与 DSH，先展示安装计划，再按确认的步骤安装到用户目录，无需 sudo。
- **模型配置移植**：将本机服务商配置、默认模型和 API 密钥复制到远程，写入前备份原文件。
- **连接管理**：在面板内重载、全屏、重启或停止远程 DSH；重新连接时优先恢复已有实例，SSH 隧道断开后自动重试。

需要 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 或更新版本。在插件管理器中添加以下来源：

```text
github:Lee-Eee-Eee/dsh-remote-dock#v0.1.5
```

安装后重启 DSH 并刷新页面，侧栏会出现 **远程**。

<details>
<summary>使用命令行安装</summary>

如果终端已能运行 `dsh`，可执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:Lee-Eee-Eee/dsh-remote-dock#v0.1.5"
```

将 `desktop` 替换成宿主实际使用的 profile；网页版通常使用 `web`。安装到其他 profile 的插件不会出现在当前宿主中。

</details>

本项目现名为 **dsh-remote-dock**，原名为 `dsh-remote`。先在当前 profile 的插件管理器中移除旧版，再添加上面的新来源并重启 DSH；新旧两份应只启用一份。已保存的目标、远程安装和模型配置会继续使用。

`dsh-remote-workspace@0.1.0-alpha.*` 是其他项目的旧 npm 包。本项目使用本页给出的 GitHub 来源安装。

1. **添加目标**：打开「远程」，点 SSH 主机或 WSL 发行版旁的 `+`。也可用「添加目标」填写 SSH 别名或主机信息。
2. **探测环境**：选择目标，点击「探测环境」。缺少 Node 或 DSH 时，打开「查看安装计划」，确认要执行的步骤后安装。

3. **准备模型**：远程尚未配置模型时，打开「移植本地配置」，选择所需的服务商、默认模型和 API 密钥组，点击「写入并重启」。API 密钥组会复制实际密钥值，请使用你信任的目标。远程已有可用模型时可跳过这步。
4. **连接**：点击「连接」，在主区打开远程 DSH，选择远程项目开始工作。连接后右侧即目标机器上的 DSH，模型与服务商沿用本机配置。

配置移植的预览只显示名称和数量，并排除本机浏览器会话凭据。远程会话与项目由嵌入的 DSH 界面管理。

多个目标可以同时保持连接，各自独立：切换目标就是切换一台机器的 DSH，互不影响。

| 操作 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 重载 | 刷新远程界面 |
| 重启 | 重新启动目标上的 DSH |
| 停止远程 | 结束目标实例并断开本地连接 |
| 关闭面板 / 退出本地 DSH | 保留远程进程，之后可重新连接 |

| 环境 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| DSH 宿主 | `0.2.1-rc.2` 或更新版本 |
| 宿主运行环境 | Node `22.x`（≥ `22.19.0`），或 `24` 及以上 |
| SSH 目标 | Linux x86_64 / arm64，使用密钥或 agent 免交互登录 |
| 自动安装环境 | `bash`、`tar`，以及 `curl` 或 `wget` |
| WSL | Windows 与发行版之间回环可达；支持 mirrored 网络或启用 localhost forwarding 的 NAT 网络 |

**安装后没有「远程」入口？** 确认安装到了当前宿主使用的 profile，然后重启 DSH、刷新页面。

**SSH 连接失败？** 先在本机终端确认 `ssh <别名>` 可以免交互登录，并且服务器允许 SSH 端口转发。密码提示不受支持。

**界面能打开，但模型无法使用？** 检查远程模型配置；使用「移植本地配置」写入后，重启远程 DSH。

**市场显示「宿主要求未知」或旧截图？** 使用 dshmarket `1.73.0` 或更新版本识别 GitHub 插件的宿主要求；截图随市场目录构建同步。见[市场展示信息](docs/architecture.md#市场展示信息)。

WSL 网络、主机密钥和内嵌认证问题见[技术参考中的排错](docs/architecture.md#排错)。

- [技术参考](docs/architecture.md)：连接架构、认证、配置移植、文件位置与排错。
- [开发与测试](CONTRIBUTING.md)：本地安装、验证命令和代码组织。
- [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [发布版本](https://github.com/Lee-Eee-Eee/dsh-remote-dock/releases)
- [提交问题或建议](https://github.com/Lee-Eee-Eee/dsh-remote-dock/issues)：请附 DSH 版本、目标类型、操作步骤及脱敏后的错误信息。

dsh-remote-dock

SSH and WSL remote workspaces inside DeepSeek Harness

简体中文 / English · Install · Usage · Docs

`dsh-remote-dock` adds a **Remote** entry to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Connect a Linux server over SSH or a WSL distribution and open its full DSH interface in your local window. File operations and commands run in the target environment. *Desktop screenshot.*

- **SSH and WSL targets.** Discover hosts from your SSH configuration and local WSL distributions, or add targets manually. SSH connections reuse local keys, ssh-agent and jump-host settings.
- **Remote setup.** Probe Node and DSH, review the installation plan, then install the selected components under the remote user's home without sudo.
- **Model configuration.** Copy local providers, the default model and API keys to the remote environment, with backups before writing.
- **Connection controls.** Reload, go fullscreen, restart or stop remote DSH from the panel. Reconnect to an existing instance, with automatic retries for dropped SSH tunnels.

Requires DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer. Add this source in the plugin manager:

```text
github:Lee-Eee-Eee/dsh-remote-dock#v0.1.5
```

Restart DSH and refresh the page. **Remote** appears in the sidebar.

<details>
<summary>Install from the command line</summary>

If `dsh` is available in your terminal, run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:Lee-Eee-Eee/dsh-remote-dock#v0.1.5"
```

Replace `desktop` with the profile your host actually uses; web hosts typically use `web`. Installing into another profile will not add the plugin to the current host.

</details>

This project is now **dsh-remote-dock**, previously `dsh-remote`. Remove the old plugin from your current profile, add the new source above, and restart DSH. Enable only one copy. Saved targets, remote installations and model configuration remain available.

`dsh-remote-workspace@0.1.0-alpha.*` belongs to a different project. Install this project using the GitHub source shown on this page.

1. **Add a target.** Open **Remote** and click **+** beside an SSH host or WSL distribution. Use **Add target** to enter an SSH alias or host details manually.
2. **Probe the environment.** Select the target and click **Probe**. If Node or DSH is missing, open **Review install plan**, choose the steps and start installation.

3. **Configure a model.** If the remote has no model configuration, open **Port local config**, select the provider, default-model and API-key groups you need, then click **Write and restart**. The API-key group copies actual secret values, so use a target you trust. Skip this step when the remote already has a working model.
4. **Connect.** Click **Connect**, then choose a remote project in the embedded DSH interface and start working. The right-hand pane is the target's own DSH, running with the model configuration you ported.
Configuration previews show names and counts only, and local browser-session credentials are excluded from porting. Remote conversations and projects are managed inside the embedded DSH interface.

Several targets can stay connected at the same time, each independent: switching targets switches which machine's DSH you are looking at.

| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| Reload | Refresh the remote interface |
| Restart | Restart DSH on the target |
| Stop remote | End the target instance and close the local connection |
| Close the panel / exit local DSH | Leave the remote process running for reconnection |

| Environment | Requirement |
|---|---|
| DSH host | `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer |
| Host runtime | Node `22.x` (≥ `22.19.0`), or `24` and newer |
| SSH target | Linux x86_64 / arm64 with non-interactive key or agent authentication |
| Automatic setup | `bash`, `tar`, and either `curl` or `wget` |
| WSL | Windows–Linux loopback reachability: mirrored networking, or NAT with localhost forwarding enabled |

**No Remote entry after installation?** Check that you installed into the current host's profile, then restart DSH and refresh the page.

**SSH connection fails?** Verify that `ssh <alias>` works without an interactive prompt and that the server permits SSH port forwarding. Password prompts are unsupported.

**The interface opens but the model does not work?** Check the remote model configuration. After applying **Port local config**, restart remote DSH.

**Unknown host requirement or old screenshots in the market?** Use dshmarket `1.73.0` or newer to read GitHub plugins' host requirements. Screenshots refresh with catalog builds. See [marketplace metadata](docs/architecture.en.md#marketplace-metadata).

For WSL networking, host-key and embedded authentication issues, see [troubleshooting](docs/architecture.en.md#troubleshooting).
